audit_items.notes: KZG polynomial recovery operations (recover_polynomialcoeff, zp_over_coset) are implemented in nim-kzg4844 external library. Vendor directory is empty - submodule not checked out. The coset shift and division operations are not in this codebase.

Division operation error handling in recover_polynomialcoeff is in nim-kzg4844 external library (vendor/nim-kzg4844). Field arithmetic and defensive validation are handled at the library level, not in this consensus layer codebase.

coset_fft_field (SG-005) and PRIMITIVE_ROOT_OF_UNITY initialization is in the KZG library. The constant correctness property for shift_factor is a library-level concern not present in this CL codebase.

Bit-reversal permutation (brp) implementation in polynomial_eval_to_coeff, coset_for_cell, coset_shift_for_cell is in the KZG cryptographic library (nim-kzg4844). These are FFT domain operations handled externally.

divide_polynomialcoeff (SG-010) vanishing polynomial construction and division by zero checking is in nim-kzg4844 library. The pre-condition check for non-zero divisor polynomial is a library responsibility.
interpolate_polynomialcoeff (SG-011) Lagrange interpolation and xs value distinctness validation is in KZG library. The coset points are derived internally by library functions.
multiply_polynomialcoeff (SG-009) pre-condition for polynomial degree bounds (FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_EXT_BLOB) is in KZG library. The vanishing polynomial size validation occurs at library level.
coset_shift_for_cell (SG-016) cell_index bounds validation and roots_brp array access is in KZG library. The CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB bounds checking occurs in library code.
coset_for_cell (SG-017) cell_index validation and slice bounds checking is in KZG library. Companion to CHK-0158 - both access roots_brp array.
cell_to_coset_evals (SG-001) byte segment validation and FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL output guarantee is in KZG library. Cell deserialization and field element extraction are library operations.
Roundtrip invariant coset_evals_to_cell(cell_to_coset_evals(cell)) == cell is a KZG library property. SG-001/SG-002 serialization functions are library internals.
_fft_field (SG-003) power-of-2 input validation is in KZG library. FFT butterfly operation correctness is a library-level concern.
Inverse FFT normalization factor 1/N computation in fft_field (SG-004) is in KZG library. The ifft(fft(p)) == p invariant and roots_of_unity reversal are library responsibilities.

compute_cells_and_kzg_proofs (SG-020) BYTES_PER_BLOB input validation is in KZG library. This codebase calls computeCellsAndKzgProofs() at beacon_chain/spec/peerdas_helpers.nim:96 but validation occurs in library.

This check is for execution layer P2P block validation of ommers. This consensus layer codebase only sets ommersHash to EMPTY_UNCLE_HASH in block construction (helpers.nim:507). EL block validation is in execution clients (geth, nethermind, etc.), not CL.
P2P peer ommers_hash validation against EMPTY_OMMER_HASH before forwarding is an execution layer concern. The CL (Nimbus beacon chain) handles consensus layer P2P, not EL block validation.
Execution engine empty ommers invariant enforcement during block execution is EL code. This CL codebase interfaces with EL via Engine API but doesn't implement block execution validation.

Trie root() determinism and order-independence is an execution layer MPT property. This is a consensus layer (CL) codebase - trie implementations are in execution layer clients. The CL uses SSZ merkleization, not MPT.
patricialize function termination guarantee is execution layer MPT code. Not present in this consensus layer codebase which uses SSZ merkleization.
trie._data ghost entry prevention after trie_set is execution layer Python spec code. This CL codebase does not implement MPT tries.
trie_get/trie_set correctness is execution layer MPT code from Python specs. CL uses SSZ-based state storage, not MPT.
Secured trie keccak256 key hashing in _prepare_trie is EL MPT code. Not in this CL codebase.
encode_node non-empty encoding invariant is EL MPT trie code. This CL uses SSZ encoding, not MPT node encoding.
encode_node Account storage root callback validation is EL state trie code. CL doesn't encode EL accounts.
get_storage_root callback correctness is EL account state management. This CL codebase handles beacon state, not EL account storage.
encode_internal_node 32-byte threshold implementation is EL MPT code. CL uses SSZ merkleization with different thresholds.
Canonical RLP encoding is EL serialization. This CL uses SSZ encoding, not RLP.
keccak256 determinism for trie operations is EL concern. CL uses keccak for different purposes (e.g., eth2digest) but MPT hashing is EL.
keccak256 collision resistance for address/storage key hashing is EL account state concern. This CL handles validator pubkeys, not EL addresses.
encode_node isinstance type dispatch is EL Python spec code. This CL codebase doesn't have this dispatch chain.
previous_trie.encode_node fallback compatibility is EL fork handling. CL has its own fork handling via ConsensusFork enum.
copy_trie deep copy isolation is EL state management. CL state copies use SSZ-based mechanisms.
trie_set deletion behavior with default value is EL MPT code. Not present in CL.
trie_set no-op for non-existent key deletion is EL MPT code. CL doesn't have this pattern.
trie_get default value identity is EL MPT code. CL state access uses different patterns.
nibble_list_to_compact nibble range validation is EL MPT hex-prefix encoding. CL doesn't use nibble encoding.
nibble_list_to_compact is_leaf flag and parity encoding is EL MPT hex-prefix encoding. Not in CL codebase.
Empty trie EMPTY_TRIE_ROOT production is EL MPT property. CL uses different empty root constants for SSZ trees.
patricialize single-element LeafNode creation is EL MPT algorithm. CL doesn't implement patricialize.
patricialize ExtensionNode shared prefix creation is EL MPT algorithm. Not in CL.
patricialize BranchNode 16-subnode creation is EL MPT algorithm. CL uses binary merkle trees, not 16-ary MPT.
patricialize BranchNode value position assertion is EL MPT code. Not in CL.
Trie root() 32-byte output guarantee is EL MPT property. CL hash_tree_root produces 32-byte roots via different mechanism.
Unsecured trie pathological structure DoS is EL MPT concern. CL doesn't have unsecured tries.
encode_node isinstance chain fork handling is EL Python spec code. CL has different fork type handling.
Unbounded state entry growth DoS is EL concern related to SSTORE gas costs. CL has different state growth constraints.
root() small node hashing (<32 bytes RLP) is EL MPT property. CL SSZ merkleization has different size thresholds.
_prepare_trie complete entry processing is EL MPT code. CL doesn't have this function.
Secured trie key hashing collision resistance is EL state trie property. CL uses different key derivation.
Trie root iteration order independence is EL MPT property. CL SSZ hash_tree_root is order-dependent by design (fields have fixed positions).
